speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing a psychiatric condition and have developed new movement symptoms. To begin, can you tell me specifically what movements you are noticing and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Parkinsonism (secondary to Risperidone).

Since your risperidone treatment has improved your psychiatric symptoms, we can rule out untreated psychosis as the primary cause. However, the new onset of movement symptoms suggests a side effect. Can you describe if your movements are rhythmic shaking (tremors) or rather a stiffness and slowness of movement?
